cohort: The study included 245 antenatal women from a selected institution in the Southern province of Sri Lanka, selected using a systematic random sampling method.
finding: While the majority of women (60.8%) had good sleep quality, the quality of sleep was found to be deprived with advancing gestational age, with the first trimester identified as a protective factor for good sleep quality compared to the other two trimesters.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, covering all three trimesters.
gest_age: The study included women across all gestational ages and found it to be a significant determinant of sleep quality.
